lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 3 Lesson 1, pdf p.43-46
lessons.goal_ar: النهارده هنتعلم أسماء أفراد العيلة ونقول مين ده.

steps.body_ar: Maya وSara بيتكلموا عن العيلة. اقرا الجمل واحدة واحدة.
en: Sara: This is my father. And this is my mother. They are my parents.
steps.body_en: Maya and Sara are talking about family. Read the sentences one at a time.

steps.body_ar: father = أب. mother = أم. parents = الأب والأم. brother = أخ. sister = أخت. grandmother = جدة. grandfather = جد. Who's this? = ده مين؟
steps.body_en: Learn these family words: father, mother, parents, brother, sister, grandmother and grandfather. Ask Who's this? to find out who someone is.

steps.body_ar: father يعني أب. mother يعني أم. parents يعني الأب والأم مع بعض.
steps.body_en: Your father and mother are your parents.

steps.body_ar: brother يعني أخ. sister يعني أخت. brothers وsisters يعني أكتر من واحد.
steps.body_en: Learn the words brother and sister. Brothers and sisters mean more than one.

steps.body_ar: grandmother يعني جدة، أم الأم أو أم الأب. grandfather يعني جد، أب الأم أو أب الأب.
steps.body_en: Your grandmother is your mother's or father's mother. Your grandfather is your mother's or father's father.

steps.body_ar: Who's this? يعني ده مين؟ والرد: This is my father.
steps.body_en: Ask Who's this? to find out who someone is. Answer: This is my father.

steps.body_ar: نقول عدد إخواتنا كده: I have 1 brother. I have 2 sisters. لما العدد أكتر من واحد نزوّد s.
steps.body_en: Say how many brothers or sisters you have like this: I have 1 brother. I have 2 sisters. Add s when there is more than one.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الكلمات عشان تعمل جملة.
steps.body_en: Put the words in order to make a sentence.

steps.body_ar: اختار الكلمة اللي مش من العيلة.
steps.title_en: The word that is not a family member
steps.body_en: Choose the word that is not a family member.

steps.body_ar: كمّل المحادثة بنفسك.
steps.body_en: Complete the conversation yourself.

steps.body_ar: father، mother، parents، brother، sister، grandmother، grandfather. Who's this? This is my ... I have 2 sisters.
steps.body_en: Father, mother, parents, brother, sister, grandmother and grandfather. Who's this? This is my ... I have 2 sisters.

lessons.goal_en: Today we will learn the names of family members and say who someone is.

lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 3 Lesson 2, pdf p.47-51
lessons.goal_ar: النهارده هنعرف حرفين: N وP، صوتهم وكلمات بتبدأ بيهم.

steps.body_ar: الحرف ليه اسم وصوت. اقرأ كلمات الدرس وشوف الحرف في أولها. الشرح هنا مكتوب، والنطق الصوتي هيتضاف بعد مراجعته.
steps.body_en: A letter has a name and a sound. Read the lesson words and find the letter at the beginning. This explanation is written; pronunciation audio will be added after review.

steps.body_ar: nose يعني أنف. بص على الصورة.
steps.body_en: Learn the word nose. Look at the picture.

steps.body_ar: nurse يعني ممرضة. بتبدأ بحرف n.
steps.body_en: Learn the word nurse. It begins with n.

steps.body_ar: nail يعني ظفر. بتبدأ بحرف n.
steps.body_en: Learn the word nail. It begins with n.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير N والصغير n. اتتبّعهم في كتابك واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is N and the small letter is n. Trace them in your book and follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: اختار الحرف اللي بتبدأ بيه الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Choose the letter that the word begins with.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الحروف وكوّن الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Put the letters in order to make the word.

steps.body_ar: الحرف ليه اسم وصوت. اقرأ كلمات الدرس وشوف الحرف في أولها. الشرح هنا مكتوب، والنطق الصوتي هيتضاف بعد مراجعته.
steps.body_en: A letter has a name and a sound. Read the lesson words and find the letter at the beginning. This explanation is written; pronunciation audio will be added after review.

steps.body_ar: pizza يعني بيتزا. بتبدأ بحرف p.
steps.body_en: Learn the word pizza. It begins with p.

steps.body_ar: pencil يعني قلم رصاص. بتبدأ بحرف p.
steps.body_en: Learn the word pencil. It begins with p.

steps.body_ar: panda يعني باندا. بتبدأ بحرف p.
steps.body_en: Learn the word panda. It begins with p.

steps.body_ar: الحرف الكبير P والصغير p. اتتبّعهم واتبع الأسهم.
steps.body_en: The capital letter is P and the small letter is p. Trace them in your book and follow the arrows.

steps.body_ar: اختار الحرف اللي بتبدأ بيه الكلمة.
steps.body_en: Choose the letter that the word begins with.

steps.body_ar: اختار الكلمة اللي بتبدأ بـ p مش n.
steps.body_en: Choose the word that begins with p, not n.

steps.body_ar: n: nose، nurse، nail، neck، net. p: pizza، pencil، panda، parrot، potato.
steps.body_en: n: nose, nurse, nail, neck, net. p: pizza, pencil, panda, parrot, potato.

lessons.goal_en: Today we will learn two letters, N and P, their sounds and words that begin with them.

lessons.source_ref: Ministry Primary 1 T1 student book, Unit 3 Lesson 3, pdf p.52-55
lessons.goal_ar: النهارده هنعد من 1 لـ 5 ونقول في كام حاجة.

steps.body_ar: Omar وAly بيعدوا حاجات. اقرا الجمل واحدة واحدة.
steps.body_en: Omar and Aly are counting things. Read the sentences one at a time.

steps.body_ar: 1 = one. 2 = two. 3 = three. 4 = four. 5 = five. اعد على صوابعك: one، two، three، four، five.
steps.body_en: 1 = one. 2 = two. 3 = three. 4 = four. 5 = five. Count on your fingers: one, two, three, four, five.

steps.body_ar: How many ...? يعني كام ...؟ وبنرد: There are 4 books. ولو واحد بس: There is 1 butterfly.
steps.body_en: Ask How many ...? to find out the number. Answer: There are 4 books. If there is only one: There is 1 butterfly.

steps.body_ar: نقول There is مع 1 بس: There is 1 sun. ونقول There are مع أكتر من واحد: There are 3 books.
steps.body_en: Use There is with 1: There is 1 sun. Use There are with more than one: There are 3 books.

steps.body_ar: عد الكتب في الصورة: كام كتاب؟
steps.body_en: Count the books in the picture. How many books are there?

steps.body_ar: عد النجوم في الصورة.
steps.body_en: Count the stars in the picture.

steps.body_ar: عد التفاح في الصورة.
steps.body_en: Count the apples in the picture.

steps.body_ar: I see 5 birds. يعني شايف 5 عصافير. لما العدد أكتر من واحد نزوّد s: bird، birds.
steps.body_en: I see 5 birds means you can see five birds. Add s when there is more than one: bird, birds.

steps.body_ar: رتّب الكلمات عشان تعمل جملة.
steps.body_en: Put the words in order to make a sentence.

steps.body_ar: كمّل المحادثة بنفسك.
steps.body_en: Complete the conversation yourself.

steps.body_ar: one، two، three، four، five. There is 1 ... There are 3 ... How many ...?
steps.body_en: One, two, three, four, five. There is 1 ... There are 3 ... How many ...?

lessons.goal_en: Today we will count from 1 to 5 and say how many things there are.
